commitResults.messageTitle: Reject unknown parameters in edit and find
commitResults.messageBody:
add already rejects flags it does not accept, but edit and find did
not. Names may contain hyphens, so a mistyped flag became part of the
value: edit --id 1 --to-name Bob --note hi saved the name
"Bob --note hi", and find --name alex --foo bar silently found nobody.

Move add's unknown-flag check into ParserUtil so that add, edit and
find share it, each with its own message. Flags inside quoted values
are still treated as part of the value.

Fixes #263
Reject unknown parameters in edit and find
